citation.policy: Sources are the only citable evidence: cite a source only for what it explicitly supports. The summary field is model-written text, never evidence. Links and model summaries are never promoted to 'confirmed' claims; if the sources do not support something, say so.

demo-aurora.title: Shimmer over Demo Ridge draws sky watchers
demo-aurora.summary: Two sources describe a slow, aurora-like shimmer over Demo Ridge on the night of 16 November: a Gazette note from the next morning and a timelapse from Quiet Orbit Lab. They agree on the timing and on little else, so the cause remains an open question.

sources.title: Sky watchers report a shimmer over Demo Ridge
sources.author: The Demo Gazette

sources.title: Night sky timelapse: the shimmer over Demo Ridge
sources.author: Quiet Orbit Lab

corrections.said: The shimmer was visible on two consecutive nights.
corrections.now: The Gazette note covers one night only; no source mentions a second night.

demo-trail.title: Demo Loop trail reopens after boardwalk repairs
demo-trail.summary: The Demo Loop footpath is passable again after its boardwalk repairs, and a walker's report confirms the new boards hold. Both sources agree the detour sign stays until the replacement fence is installed.
